name: Standard Bank
evidence: Standard Bank's own global locations page gives its South African contact address as Standard Bank of South Africa Limited, 3 Simmonds Street, Johannesburg, 2001.
note_append: Two entities are involved and the dossier keeps them apart. The group's own homepage lists its ordinary shares on the JSE as STANDARD BANK GROUP LTD, which is the legal name recorded here. The South African operating bank, whose 3 Simmonds Street address this record carries, is Standard Bank of South Africa Limited - a subsidiary, not the group itself.
